title.justification: The paper introduces and proposes the Recurrent Independent Mechanisms (RIMs), a new recurrent architecture.
title.quote: We propose Recurrent Independent Mechanisms (RIMs), a new recurrent architecture in which multiple groups of recurrent cells operate with nearly independent transition dynamics.

analysis.description: The paper explores the hypothesis that learning modular structures that reflect the dynamics of the environment can lead to better generalization and robustness. It introduces Recurrent Independent Mechanisms (RIMs), a recurrent architecture with multiple groups of recurrent cells that operate independently and interact sparsely through attention mechanisms. The paper demonstrates the effectiveness of RIMs in various tasks that require generalization across different environments and conditions.

type.justification: The paper conducts experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of the RIMs in improving generalization in various tasks.
type.quote: The main goal of our experiments is to show that the use of RIMs improves generalization across changing environments and/or in modular tasks, and to explore how it does so.

name.value: Modular and Sparse Architectures in Deep Learning
name.justification: The paper proposes a new architecture that emphasizes modularity and sparse interactions within neural networks.
name.quote: We propose Recurrent Independent Mechanisms (RIMs), a new recurrent architecture in which multiple groups of recurrent cells operate with nearly independent transition dynamics, communicate only sparingly through the bottleneck of attention, and compete with each other.

name.justification: The core contribution of the paper is a new recurrent architecture, the RIMs.

name.justification: The paper utilizes attention mechanisms to enable sparse communication between independent modules.
